items.docs: List the authenticated user's ACH transfers. Transfers are movements of funds between two internal accounts or two verified external accounts. All monetary values are represented in minor units, or the smallest unit of the currency with no decimal (e.g., cents). For example, $10.00 is represented as 1000. How can we improve these docs? Share your feedback.

Transfer funds between two accounts. The target accounts should be either an account at the financial institution belonging to the user or a verified external account.

A list of eligible accounts can be retrieved or listed from the accounts endpoints.

If the `instant` flag is provided for a push external transfer, processing will be done via FedNow and core posting will be immediate, otherwise all external transfers are processed via ACH by default.
